اعلوطتم (form XIII)
# اِعْلَوَّطْتُمْ (iʕlawwaṭtum) /iʕ.law.watˤ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# اُعْلُوِّطْتُمْ (uʕluwwiṭtum) /uʕ.luw.witˤ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
